title: ワープ救助隊、全員まとめて！ ～WARP RESCUE～
tagline: 入口で拾って、開いた出口へ一斉送還。
coreMechanic: 60 capsules in 12 waves on a fixed integer-ms timetable fall at 100px/s to 3 inlet sensors. Inlet selection (Q/W/E) captures; the outlet (A/S/D) selected at the crossing is fixed and the capsule arrives 450ms later. Dock i is OPEN when (t−1000−1800i) mod 5400 < 2700.

inputs.select: 6 DOM buttons: round 入口 (mint) and square 出口 (coral), pointerdown; each selector has its own 80ms cooldown
inputs.pause: button / Esc / P; blur and hidden auto-pause

practice: Waves 1–2 (10 capsules), separate score, no BEST
scoring: Rescue: 100×min(3, 1+floor(streak/10)); reroute or inlet miss resets streak. Wave of 5 all rescued: +300, all same dock: +500 instead. Clear (≥42) +1000; all 60 +1000. Reading plan: 21,200.
save: web-mini-arcade:v1:ct3:warp_rescue:best:rules1 (JSON best record), web-mini-arcade:v1:ct3:warp_rescue:settings (mute / reduced motion); denied/corrupt storage → in-memory with on-screen note; never enumerates other keys
telemetry: none in staging (no analytics/records calls); Codex to connect existing services in native adapter
art: Procedural code-drawn sprites only (BLOCKED_ART: ImageGen not available/approved in the production session). Not final art.
audio: WebAudio synthesized SE (no samples), voice cap 10, compressor/limiter, mute; not listened to by a human
humanReview: author / physical device / audio-feel / Windows launcher review pending
note: Candidate only. Shape follows src/games/game035/game.manifest.json; Codex assigns id and adapts to the current manifest schema.
